database: ginsengfood-ivr-dev-postgres-1 (PostgreSQL 16.14), the database the PT-SOAK-02 run was writing to at the time; read-only statements only
query: The drift comparison of AnalyticsEtlJob.SyncJobFactsAsync as the refresh issues it (ORDER BY job id, LIMIT 5000). It runs twice per ETL run: once to fetch the drifted facts, once to count what is left after the refresh.

before.source: SQL captured from pg_stat_activity while a worker ran it (e95ba64, W-0353)
before.shape: three correlated count subqueries per job fact (SubPlan 1 in the projection, SubPlan 2 and 3 in the join filter), each a sequential scan of ivr_call_attempts
before.why_no_index: The only index leading with ivr_call_job_id is IX_ivr_call_attempts_ivr_call_job_id_attempt_number, partial WHERE (is_counted_customer_attempt IS TRUE); the planner does not prove that predicate from the bare boolean filter EF writes

after.source: The W-0355 shape: counted attempts grouped once (GROUP BY ivr_call_job_id) and left-joined; written by hand to match the EF translation, whose own plan BI-DRIFT-08 checks
after.shape: Hash Join of facts and jobs, Hash Left Join to one aggregate over ivr_call_attempts; no SubPlan

same_rows.method: md5 over string_agg of every output row ordered by job id, each query in its own REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY transaction

consequence_before: At this size the query alone exceeds the 30-second command timeout, so the run fails with 'Timeout during reading attempt'. In the retained worker logs at 12:15 no ETL run had completed on either worker (soak-log-counts.json).
